# Vendored Monaco Editor

This is the minified AMD build of [monaco-editor](https://www.npmjs.com/package/monaco-editor)
`v0.52.2`, copied from `node_modules/monaco-editor/min/vs`. It is committed so the
IDE runs with **no build step and no CDN** — local editing works fully offline.

To update: `npm install monaco-editor@<version>` then copy `min/vs` here.
Non-English `nls.messages.*.js` localization files were removed to save space.
